resources.string: Lets you say \"ListenLock, pause\", \"play\", \"next\", \"back\", \"repeat\", \"faster\" or \"slower\" with the reader open. Everything is heard on your phone; nothing is recorded or sent. Needs %1$d MB.
While the reader is on screen, ListenLock listens for \"ListenLock\" and a command, and Android shows the microphone indicator. Uses a little battery while it listens.
Download the voice commands model first.
Keep listening with the screen off

plurals.name: commands_screen_off_body
plurals.item: While a book is open in the reader, ListenLock also listens with the screen off or in another app, and shows a notification you can stop it from. To save battery it stops once reading has been paused for %1$d minute and the reader is off screen.

While a book is open in the reader, ListenLock also listens with the screen off or in another app, and shows a notification you can stop it from. To save battery it stops once reading has been paused for %1$d minutes and the reader is off screen.

resources.string: Listening with the screen off needs notifications, so you can always see it and stop it. You can allow them in Android\'s app settings.
Voice commands need the microphone. You can allow it in Android\'s app settings.
